note: The frozen reference renders of the bank (83) and the envelope presets (12) on the four phrases, by today's engine, at 48000 Hz (the same engine, settings and level as the 44100 Hz set, whose manifest.json is unchanged; the parameters are parameters.json's). The audio is the release asset below, not in git. Generated by tools/engine2_reference_renders.mjs; `--verify <dir> --sr 48000` checks a copy of the audio against this file. Levels are of the 24-bit samples the WAV holds: peak and rms are linear, per channel (left, right); the dBFS columns are 20*log10 of them, rounded to 0.01.

asset.name: engine2-reference-renders-v1-48k.zip
asset.contents: the WAV files named below, flat, and a copy of this manifest-48k.json

format.length: each phrase's length (its last note-off) plus the tail
format.phrase_timing: an event's sample is round(time_s * rate) from phrases.json (which gives samples at 44.1 kHz); a phrase's length is its last note-off's sample

engine.harness: h2/harness/render_cli.cpp, the composed engine's adapter, built -O3 -ffp-contract=off

settings.order: the preset keys, gain, os, frameHold, stealFade, snap, poly, then the phrase (as tools/h2_ab.mjs plays a preset)
